name: Watashi
source: Watashi is a man who finds himself stuck in a forest in the middle of the night. While trying to escape, he comes across a female kitsune by the name of [url=/c72129]Aiko Kitsune Chan[/url] who needs his helping rescuing a tsukihime ("Moon Princess").
translation: Watashi is a man who finds himself stuck in a forest in the middle of the night. While trying to escape, he comes across a female kitsune by the name of [url=/c72129]Aiko Kitsune Chan[/url] who needs his helping rescuing a tsukihime ("Moon Princess").
